$comment: Tool registry for binaries shipped alongside the sdlc plugin.
Single source of truth for both the GH Actions release workflow (matrix
derived via jq) and the plugin-side install primitive (plugin/lib/tools.sh).
Versioning is coupled to the plugin: every release tag attaches one tarball
per (tool × platform) cell, named `<tool>-<platform>.tar.gz`. The version
downloaded at runtime is whatever is set in plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json.
Release workflow + plugin-side install pick it up automatically.

cc-viewer.description: Self-contained Claude Code session viewer (Hono + bun:sqlite + embedded React SPA).

cc-bridge.description: Local daemon that tails CC session JSONL transcripts and forwards new lines to cc-viewer as TranscriptDelta events.
